title: MessageHeader
description: The header of a lifecycle notification, with the properties of the Catena-X message header in version 3.0.0.

messageId.description: The identifier of the message, unique per message.

context.description: The context of the operation, as Table 4.3 of the proposal CX-0160-4 states the context.

sentDateTime.description: The date and time at which the sender sent the message, with a time zone.

senderBpn.description: The Business Partner Number of the legal entity that sends the message.

receiverBpn.description: The Business Partner Number of the legal entity that receives the message.

version.description: The version of the message header.

expectedResponseBy.description: The date and time by which the sender expects a response.

relatedMessageId.description: The identifier of a message to which this message relates.
